race.comment: EXPENSIVE TASTE (13) has been about the mark this time in, sent out a $2.60 chance at Ballarat Synthetic last time, battling away for fourth. She's a G2 placegetter who should now be suited rising to 2000m and will take catching. DOUBLET (1) looks suited rising in trip fourth up, getting home well for second on heavy ground at Moe when last seen. Fitter again now and will prove hard to beat. DR WELL (2) has been good in two runs to date over 1400m and 1600m and now looks suited rising up in trip. Open to more and can figure. ROCK CATCHER (8) struggled out to this trip at Seymour on heavy but had been going well prior and on to firmer can suit. KNUCKLEHEAD (3) was beaten less than a length last time and is in the mix again.
